item.content:encoded: Yes, essentially. They were attempting to use the stones, and Sibu's knowledge of the stones, to create adaptive, reality bending, self sustainable containment units. In fact they had pretty much succeeded and if not for them inadvertently making Sibu an all powerful reality bender they would have continued.

I find this pretty cool, especially the way Sibu is as powerful as people believe him to be (similar to SCP-2950). I recently visited the Museo del Oro and saw the exhibits about Talamancan cosmology. There still seem to be a few unanswered questions, like what exactly the Foundation was trying to do with Sibu (I assume use him to create containment units?).

I hope you don't mind, I fixed some typos and put the scientific names in proper format.
